crack.definition: finite rectangle on y=0 from x=-0.01 m up to but excluding front x=0 m, with the stated finite z interval

front.definition: finite straight segment; distance uses clamped z projection

support.shape: Omega intersect closed Euclidean ball centered at the source
support.kernel_reference: Wendland C2; this certificate only evaluates compact support topology

topology.classify_against: finite crack rectangle and finite front segment only
topology.heaviside_full_split_rule: the complete box-clipped support-plane section y=0 must lie in finite Gamma; both y-side pieces must be nonempty; the support must have positive clearance from finite F; shifted source-side value must be defined
topology.front_rule: support intersects finite F with positive margin; shifted F1 source value must be single-valued
topology.unknown_policy: all tangencies, tolerance-band cases, partial finite-crack intersections, undefined shifted-source values, and malformed/out-of-domain records are UNKNOWN

derived_geometry_bounds.front_core_definition: minimum distance from finite F to a non-front source center minus h
